newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bond market at virtual standstill.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bond market at virtual standstill.

text.p: Argentina's local bond market was at a virtual standstill Thursday as many traders stayed away from work because of a general strike and the holiday season.
"Until the first or second of January nothing is going to happen," said a trader at a local bank.
The market was shut on Wednesday for Christmas and the general strike by unions protesting government labor reforms Thursday meant there was no trade of significance this session.
Just a couple of trades were recorded on screens.
The dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was quoted $0.60 higher at 123.10.
Argentina's Brady bonds traded abroad were higher. The FRB due 2005 was 1/2 up at 87-1/4.
